name: Timing
overview: Scripture reveals that God's timing is sovereign and perfect, unfolding according to His appointed seasons and purposes, as seen in Genesis 18:14 where God promises fulfillment at the right time. Believers are called to trust in the Lord's timing (Psalms 31:14) and to wait patiently for His promises, even when they seem delayed (Habakkuk 2:3). The certainty of God's plan encourages endurance and faithfulness until the end (Matthew 24:13), while also acknowledging that the exact timing of future events is known only by the Father (Matthew 24:36).
